map_amendments.reason: Original R127 proof conditions on common b,q. The map abbreviated this qualification and could be misused for marginal internal C when the decoder also uses external B.
map_amendments.counterexample: Existing fair-mask model C=X XOR B with fair independent B: marginal C laws have TV=0; joint (C,B) or common-b conditional C laws have TV=1 and perfect recovery.
